::: {.lead}
Indianapolis Colts finished 2025 at 8&ndash;9. The model grades them as a balanced: competent in both phases, elite in neither. The league's default state.
:::

## What the four phases look like

::: {.sec-note}
EPA **per play** in each of the four phases. Blue is creating points, red is costing them. Defence is sign-flipped so longer blue always means better. All four bars share one league-wide scale (max 0.306 EPA/play), so they are comparable to each other *and* to every other team page. Season totals are deliberately not used here &mdash; mixing totals and per-play rates on one axis would make the offence bars look four times longer than they are.
:::

## Identity

This team classifies as **Balanced** &mdash; *Competent in both phases, elite in neither. The league's default state.*

Underneath, the offence reads as **"Complementary Rushing"**: the label describes how the offence distributes its production between the run and the pass, not how good it is.

| Dimension | Grade |
|---|---|
| Offence tier | **Competent** |
| Defence tier | **Competent** |
| Pass defence rank | **#18** |
| Rush defence rank | **#9** |
| Wins above / below model | **-2.2** |

## Personnel

**Quarterback.** **R.Leonard** closed the season at **-1.225 EPA per dropback** and **-51.5% CPOE** over his rolling five-game window (through week 18).

**Running back.** **J.Taylor** led the backfield with **318 carries** at **0.058 EPA per rush** (4.9 YPC, 44.3% success). Blocking versus creation: **2.6** yards before contact, **2.4** after. Style: *Efficient creator*.

## 2026 outlook

The multi-year prior model projects **8.2 wins** for 2026, with a 90% interval of **1.6 to 14.8**. Fragility flag: **Neutral**.
